ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: fishing together
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They fish the same water side by side, and talk in low voices so as not to scare anything off.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: the hot water
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They soak together in the hot water: a pool, a hot tub, a sauna or a hot spring.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: a pot of tea or coffee
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They drink tea or coffee at the same table and talk over the day.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: cards, chess or darts
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They play cards, chess or darts together of an evening, and argue about the score.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: fishing
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and fish the same water together.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: the hot water
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and soak in the hot water together.

plain.li: Something's nibbling at mine.
Keep your voice down, they can hear you.
That one got away, and it was this big.
The water's colder than yesterday.
Pass me the bait, would you?
I'll have one before you do, watch.
Best part of the day, this.
Nothing yet, but I'm in no hurry.
[morning] They bite best early, everyone knows that.
[winter] My fingers are too cold to tie a hook.
[rain] Fish don't mind the rain, so why should we?
[child] Can I hold the line for a bit?
[grouprole:joker] I'm not fishing, I'm feeding them.
[grouprole:anchor] Same spot tomorrow, then.
[grouprole:quiet] Shh.
[grouprole:newcomer] How do you tell when it's a bite?
[groupkind:hunters] It's the same as stalking, only wetter.

warm.li: I don't care if we catch anything, I like the company.

gloomy.li: They're not biting, and they won't.

cold.li: That's three for me and none for you.

plain.li: I'm not getting out until I can't feel my back.
Move over a bit, there's room.
That's the first time I've been warm all week.
Don't splash, I've just got comfortable.
My shoulders needed this.
Who left the towel in the water?
Five more minutes, then supper.
[winter] Hard to believe there's snow outside.
[child] Can I jump in?
[grouprole:joker] I'm going to live in here from now on.
[grouprole:anchor] We should do this every evening.
[grouprole:quiet] Ahh.
[grouprole:worrier] Is it meant to be this hot?
[groupkind:elders] My knees thank you all.

warm.li: This is the best thing the colony ever built.

cheerful.li: I could fall asleep right here.

gloomy.li: Back to the cold in a minute.

cold.li: It loosens the muscles, that's all.

plain.li: Is there any left in the pot?
This one's stronger than yesterday's.
Sit down, I'll pour.
How's your day been so far?
I needed this.
Too hot, give it a minute.
Who made this, it's good.
[morning] I'm not awake until the second cup.
[winter] Hold it with both hands, it warms you up.
[lowtech] Leaves from the hill, the good ones.
[child] Can I have a little?
[grouprole:joker] I take mine with a lot of gossip.
[grouprole:anchor] Same time tomorrow?
[grouprole:quiet] Thanks.
[grouprole:newcomer] How do you take yours?
[groupkind:kitchen] I'll make the next pot properly.
[groupkind:elders] We drank it stronger when I was young.

warm.li: A cup with friends is the best part of the morning.

cold.li: It keeps me working, that's what it's for.

plain.li: Your turn, and don't take all night.
That's not how the rules go.
I had a better hand than that, I swear.
Check.
Double or nothing.
Who's keeping score?
One more round, then bed.
Right in the middle, did you see that?
[child] Can I play the next one?
[grouprole:joker] I'm not cheating, I'm just very lucky.
[grouprole:anchor] Same table tomorrow night.
[grouprole:quiet] Mine.
[grouprole:firebrand] Again, I want a rematch.
[grouprole:newcomer] Can someone explain the rules again?
[groupkind:scholars] Three moves from now you lose your queen.
[groupkind:comrades] We played this in the barracks every night.

warm.li: I don't mind losing to you lot.
